instincts.trigger: writing or changing code that connects to MongoDB
instincts.action: wrap the connection in a try/except with a short serverSelectionTimeoutMS and fall back to LocalFallbackDB; log a warning instead of raising
call registry.ensure_view(dataset_id, normalized_path) immediately before executing SQL, then query the ds_<dataset_id> view

instincts.trigger: writing a guard around the database handle
instincts.action: compare with 'is not None' instead of truthiness, because PyMongo/async DB objects raise NotImplementedError on __bool__

instincts.trigger: adding dashboards, samples, seeds, or demo screens
instincts.action: do not add mock/template data; drive the view only from real user-uploaded datasets
filter by project_id so datasets never leak across projects/workspaces

instincts.trigger: running profiling, healing, or the model tournament
instincts.action: explicitly handle boolean columns, single-class targets, and very small row counts rather than assuming continuous numeric data

instincts.trigger: using an LLM provider for analysis or semantic interpretation
instincts.action: try the active provider (Groq/Gemini) and fall back to a deterministic NullProvider when no key is configured; never invent business meaning

instincts.trigger: building a test/inference feature frame in the ML engineer or tournament
instincts.action: preserve the exact feature-name order used during fit time
run pytest from the backend/ directory so the app imports as top-level 'app'

instincts.trigger: writing a commit message in this repo
instincts.action: use conventional-commit format with a scope, e.g. fix(database): ..., feat(dashboard): ..., docs: ...

instincts.trigger: storing datasets, Parquet, models, or artifacts
instincts.action: keep them on disk in the gitignored storage dirs; store only metadata/audit state in MongoDB

instincts.trigger: declaring a task finished on the frontend
instincts.action: run npm run build (tsc -b && vite build); there is no frontend test runner
